Service recovery

LOC-05 follows up far less of its declined work than any other store: 91.6% of its declined recommendations got no follow-up and no recovery, against 44.7% at the other stores. Its recovered work is the lowest in the group.

How it is measured

Funnel
Counts from core.fact_service_recommendation (declined, with a follow-up event, with a recovery event). The build checks them against FO-13, FO-15 and FO-16 for every store.
Money
The open estimate is an advisor quote, not revenue. Recovered gross is associated with the follow-up, not proven to be caused by it: there is no control group.
Source
Tiles: FO-13, FO-17 and Q-SVC-01 to 04 (DAX export). Queue: mart.app_service_recovery_queue; recovered lines: mart.app_service_recovery_linked.
Flag rule
Ranks first and more than 2 standard deviations from the other stores. For recovered gross, low is the signal.

Where the checks point

Each chart compares the flagged store with the mean of the other 7. The charts use different scales, so compare within a chart, not across them.
